rows.text: 多片式离合器也有湿式油浴型，并非只能是干式。
evidence: Honda, 2015 CRF250R Owner’s Manual, Technical Information p. 161, https://cdn.powersports.honda.com/documentum/MWOM/ml.remawmom.2015_31krn7100_crf250r.pdf: wet multi-plate clutch and foot-operated five-speed gearbox; clutch lever in operating instructions.

rows.text: 多片式离合器也可配合手动变速箱使用，例如某些摩托车。
evidence: Honda, 2015 CRF250R Owner’s Manual, Technical Information p. 161, https://cdn.powersports.honda.com/documentum/MWOM/ml.remawmom.2015_31krn7100_crf250r.pdf: wet multi-plate clutch and foot-operated five-speed gearbox; clutch lever in operating instructions.

rows.text: 没有离合器踏板不代表没有变速箱：自动控制装置可以操纵自动化变速箱的离合器。
evidence: ZF, ConAct, https://www.zf.com/products/en/cv/products_64155.html: electronically controlled pneumatic clutch actuator on automated manual transmissions.

rows.text: 自动化离合器由控制装置操纵，驾驶员无需踩踏板；踏板不会被锁在踩下位置。
evidence: ZF, ConAct, https://www.zf.com/products/en/cv/products_64155.html: electronically controlled pneumatic clutch actuator on automated manual transmissions.

rows.text: 自动化离合器由控制装置操纵，驾驶员无需踩踏板；踏板不会被锁在抬起位置。
evidence: ZF, ConAct, https://www.zf.com/products/en/cv/products_64155.html: electronically controlled pneumatic clutch actuator on automated manual transmissions.

rows.text: 离合器可以自动操纵，同时车辆仍有变速箱；没有踏板不代表没有变速箱。
evidence: ZF, ConAct, https://www.zf.com/products/en/cv/products_64155.html: electronically controlled pneumatic clutch actuator on automated manual transmissions.

rows.text: 自动离合器控制可与自动化变速箱配合使用，并不会取消变速箱。
evidence: ZF, ConAct, https://www.zf.com/products/en/cv/products_64155.html: electronically controlled pneumatic clutch actuator on automated manual transmissions.

rows.text: 离合器连接发动机和传动系统，并允许逐渐接合，使扭矩逐步传至驱动轮。
evidence: Eaton, Heavy Duty Clutches Service Manual CLSM0200, pp. 127–133, https://www.eaton.com/content/dam/eaton/products/clutches-brakes/commercial-vehicle/eaton-heavy-duty-clutch-service-manual-installation-instructions-en.pdf: pedal release compresses the disc for full torque transmission; initial slip during launch permits gradual engagement.

ZF Aftermarket, Calibrating ConAct, https://aftermarket.zf.com/en/aftermarket-portal/knowledge-hub/calibrating-conact/: at the kiss point the clutch slowly engages and force reaches the transmission input shaft.

rows.text: 踩下踏板时，操纵机构带动分离轴承，轴承作用于机构使离合器分离。
evidence: ZF Aftermarket, Clutches and actuation, https://media-aftermarket.zf.com/us/aftermarket-portal/our-portfolio/passenger-cars/products/clutches/: pedal operates release bearing through hydraulic cylinders or mechanical cable and fork.

rows.text: 离合器盘的摩擦材料在接合时因摩擦而磨损，可能需要更换离合器盘。
evidence: Eaton, Heavy Duty Clutches Service Manual CLSM0200, pp. 127–133, https://www.eaton.com/content/dam/eaton/products/clutches-brakes/commercial-vehicle/eaton-heavy-duty-clutch-service-manual-installation-instructions-en.pdf: clutch disc friction material wears as it slips against flywheel and pressure plate during launch and gear changes; an excessively worn slipping clutch needs replacement.

rows.text: 频繁起步和长时间打滑会加剧摩擦衬片磨损，因此驾驶方式有影响。
evidence: ZF Aftermarket, Clutch Slipping, https://aftermarket.zf.com/en/aftermarket-portal/for-workshops/useful-tips/clutches/clutch-slipping/: friction facings wear; frequent starts and driving style contribute; worn facings can cause slip.

rows.text: 过载会加重离合器的负担，尤其是在起步时，并可能加快磨损。
evidence: Eaton, Heavy Duty Clutches Service Manual CLSM0200, pp. 127–133, https://www.eaton.com/content/dam/eaton/products/clutches-brakes/commercial-vehicle/eaton-heavy-duty-clutch-service-manual-installation-instructions-en.pdf: Factors That Affect Clutch Performance, excessive load forces the clutch to pick up the load with a greater speed difference and damages it; clutch wear arises from slip during launch and gear changes.

rows.text: 有些操纵系统需要按制造商说明检查和调整踏板间隙或行程；其他系统可自动调整。
evidence: Honda, 2015 CRF250R Owner’s Manual, clutch system section and Technical Information, https://cdn.powersports.honda.com/documentum/MWOM/ml.remawmom.2015_31krn7100_crf250r.pdf: clutch lever freeplay inspection and adjustment, and manual five-speed gearbox.

ZF Aftermarket, Clutches and actuation, https://media-aftermarket.zf.com/us/aftermarket-portal/our-portfolio/passenger-cars/products/clutches/: pedal operates release bearing through hydraulic cylinders or mechanical cable and fork.

Eaton, Heavy Duty Clutches Service Manual CLSM0200, https://manuals.plus/m/5ced050a678a33cb263607d4203a83f982fcff82eb5cd041b6c6ae94b3bd6861: manual adjustment and self-adjusting clutch variants; pedal linkage free play.

rows.text: 在传统操纵系统中，松开踏板时弹簧压紧离合器盘，使离合器接合；踩下踏板则使其分离。
evidence: Eaton, Heavy Duty Clutches Service Manual CLSM0200, pp. 127–133, https://www.eaton.com/content/dam/eaton/products/clutches-brakes/commercial-vehicle/eaton-heavy-duty-clutch-service-manual-installation-instructions-en.pdf: driver instructions describe depressing the pedal to interrupt torque and slowly releasing it as discs are compressed and clutch fully engages.

Valeo, Valeoscope Commercial Vehicles Clutch 2020, pp. 8–9, 14–16, https://valeoservice.cld.bz/Valeoscope-CV-Clutch-2020/1: diaphragm effort compresses the disc; the release bearing acts on the diaphragm to disengage it.

rows.text: 离合器盘轮毂通过花键连接变速箱输入轴；即使离合器盘与飞轮分离，它仍与输入轴相连。
evidence: Valeo, Valeoscope Commercial Vehicles Clutch 2020, pp. 8–9, 14–16, https://valeoservice.cld.bz/Valeoscope-CV-Clutch-2020/1: the disc has a splined hub fitted to the gearbox primary shaft.

ZF Aftermarket, Installing Clutches, step 4, https://aftermarket.zf.com/en/aftermarket-portal/knowledge-hub/installing-clutches/: the input shaft fits the hub spline, with axial mobility required for declutching.

rows.text: 液压操纵中，踏板驱动主缸；传到工作缸的压力推动分离轴承，使离合器分离。
evidence: ZF Aftermarket, Clutches and actuation, https://media-aftermarket.zf.com/us/aftermarket-portal/our-portfolio/passenger-cars/products/clutches/: pedal operates release bearing through hydraulic cylinders or mechanical cable and fork.

rows.text: 操纵系统可以使用压缩空气，包括辅助液压回路，来帮助驱动分离机构。
evidence: ZF, Clutch Control, https://www.zf.com/products/en/cv/products_64555.html?pageLink=contact_divider658792: hydraulic manual clutch controls and servos ease operation in commercial vehicles; ZF Aftermarket https://aftermarket.zf.com/en/aftermarket-portal/our-portfolio/trucks-trailers-buses/products/: hydraulic clutch controls with pneumatic air assistance for manual transmissions.

ZF Aftermarket, Clutches and actuation, https://media-aftermarket.zf.com/us/aftermarket-portal/our-portfolio/passenger-cars/products/clutches/: pedal operates release bearing through hydraulic cylinders or mechanical cable and fork.

rows.text: 拉索和拨叉可以将踏板动作以机械方式传给分离轴承。
evidence: ZF Aftermarket, Clutches and actuation, https://media-aftermarket.zf.com/us/aftermarket-portal/our-portfolio/passenger-cars/products/clutches/: pedal operates release bearing through hydraulic cylinders or mechanical cable and fork.

rows.text: 踏板松开时，压盘将离合器盘压向飞轮，使扭矩得以传递。
evidence: Eaton, Heavy Duty Clutches Service Manual CLSM0200, pp. 127–133, https://www.eaton.com/content/dam/eaton/products/clutches-brakes/commercial-vehicle/eaton-heavy-duty-clutch-service-manual-installation-instructions-en.pdf: on pedal release the discs are compressed and the clutch fully engages; wear occurs at disc interfaces with flywheel and pressure plate.
Valeo, Valeoscope Commercial Vehicles Clutch 2020, pp. 8–9, 14–16, https://valeoservice.cld.bz/Valeoscope-CV-Clutch-2020/1: diaphragm effort compresses the disc.

rows.text: 摩擦衬片过度磨损时，离合器可能无法传递所需扭矩，离合器盘会相对飞轮打滑。
evidence: Eaton, Heavy Duty Clutches Service Manual CLSM0200, pp. 127–133, https://www.eaton.com/content/dam/eaton/products/clutches-brakes/commercial-vehicle/eaton-heavy-duty-clutch-service-manual-installation-instructions-en.pdf: wear of the friction material reduces clamping load; below a critical level the clutch cannot carry full torque and slips, with relative slip at the flywheel and pressure plate.

rows.text: 逐渐松开踏板可使离合器逐步接合，让起步更平稳。
evidence: ZF, Calibrating ConAct, https://aftermarket.zf.com/en/aftermarket-portal/for-workshops/useful-tips/clutches/calibrating-conact/: clutch gradually engages at kiss point and transmits force to gearbox input shaft; UK DVSA examiner guidance section 11 https://www.gov.uk/guidance/guidance-for-driving-examiners-carrying-out-driving-tests-dt1/11-guide-to-assessment-and-marking: smooth clutch control for starting.

rows.text: 在重型车辆中，液压操纵可配合助力装置，帮助操作离合器并减轻踩踏板所需的力。
evidence: ZF, Clutch Control, https://www.zf.com/products/en/cv/products_64555.html?pageLink=contact_divider658792: commercial-vehicle hydraulic manual controls include clutch servos that ease operation.

Valeo, Valeoscope Commercial Vehicles Clutch 2020, pp. 8–9, 14–16, https://valeoservice.cld.bz/Valeoscope-CV-Clutch-2020/1: clutch master cylinder converts pedal force to hydraulic pressure; a clutch booster amplifies actuation for manual transmissions.

rows.text: 气液操纵也适用于商用车辆：压缩空气可以辅助液压离合器操纵。
evidence: ZF, Clutch Control, https://www.zf.com/products/en/cv/products_64555.html?pageLink=contact_divider658792: hydraulic manual clutch controls and servos ease operation in commercial vehicles; ZF Aftermarket https://aftermarket.zf.com/en/aftermarket-portal/our-portfolio/trucks-trailers-buses/products/: hydraulic clutch controls with pneumatic air assistance for manual transmissions.

rows.text: 题库判为FALSO：仅凭气液式离合器操纵方式不能确定普遍的一挡停车规则。应使用驻车制动，并遵循车辆关于挡位和止轮楔的说明。
evidence: Official superiori question 29759 retains its printed verdict.

Freightliner Cargo driver manual https://dtnacontent-dtna.prd.freightliner.com/content/dam/public/dtna-servicelit/dtna/pdfs/en_us/freightliner/drivers-manuals/Cargo%20Driver%27s%20Manual_.pdf : model-specific parking guidance; not proof of clutch type or prohibition of first gear.

rows.text: 正常挂挡行驶时，离合器接合并传递飞轮的扭矩；分离离合器时才暂时断开。
evidence: Eaton, Heavy Duty Clutches Service Manual CLSM0200, pp. 127–133, https://www.eaton.com/content/dam/eaton/products/clutches-brakes/commercial-vehicle/eaton-heavy-duty-clutch-service-manual-installation-instructions-en.pdf: during gear changes the pedal interrupts torque, then releasing it compresses the discs until the clutch fully engages and carries engine torque; the disc contacts the flywheel.

review.author: gpt-6.1-terra / collaboration /root/terra_author
reviewer_evidence: ZF clutch controls and Eaton RT-18 driver instructions independently inspected; parking explanation does not infer a universal first-gear requirement from clutch actuation.

issues.reason: The printed false verdict rejects an unconditional first-gear parking instruction for a vehicle with a pneumatic-hydraulic clutch, but the sources checked do not establish a parking exception for an identified vehicle with that clutch control. The precise scope or intended exception requires independent adjudication.
checked_sources: Freightliner Cargo Driver’s Manual, brakes operation, p. 7.2, https://dtnacontent-dtna.prd.freightliner.com/content/dam/public/dtna-servicelit/dtna/pdfs/en_us/freightliner/drivers-manuals/Cargo%20Driver%27s%20Manual_.pdf: shift to neutral during a stop and apply spring parking brakes when parking; clutch actuation type is not identified in the cited instruction.

ZF Clutch Control, https://www.zf.com/products/en/cv/products_64555.html?pageLink=contact_divider658792: describes commercial vehicle hydraulic clutch controls and servos, but does not give parking gear instructions.

UK DVSA national standard, element 2.1.4, https://www.gov.uk/guidance/national-standard-for-driving-cars-and-light-vans-category-b/role-2-guide-and-control-the-vehicle: discusses parking brake and suitable gear for cars and light vans, not the specified heavy-vehicle clutch.
